input_output_options.title: Input & Output Options
input_output_options.description: Define the input and output data locations.

input.description: Path to directory containing input files (*.bam or *.fastq.gz). Supports local paths and AWS S3 URIs.

outdir.description: Output directory. Supports local paths and AWS S3 URIs.

pool_ID.description: Unique identifier for the sequencing run. Used in the demux summary report filename.

check_inputs.description: Read the first and last input file end to end before Dorado starts, and stop with a clear message if either is corrupt, truncated or empty. Off by default. A single file that is split is always checked by the split step.

check_all_inputs.description: Read every input file end to end before Dorado starts and list any that are corrupt, truncated or empty. Off by default; suggested when a run fails while reading input files. Implies --check_inputs.

data_type.description: Input file format. Must be 'bam' or 'fastq'. BAM input produces FASTQ and filtered BAM outputs; FASTQ input produces FASTQ outputs only.

barcodes.description: Path to the barcode FASTA file.

arrangement_toml.description: Path to the barcode arrangement TOML configuration file for Dorado.

length_filter.description: Minimum read length (bp) to retain after trimming.

error_rate.description: Maximum error rate for detecting the ME and P5 adapters in CUTADAPT_FILTER step 2; reads containing either (either orientation, anywhere) are set aside as ME/P5-tagged. Errors allowed = floor(error_rate x matched adapter length): with 0.106, 2 in the 19-nt ME and 3 in the 29-nt P5.
